reason: The development tuning macro F1 of all ten scratch MobileNetV3 fits remained at the majority-class level. A separate ImageNet frozen-feature reference avoids treating that training failure as a competitive lightweight baseline.
scope: Additional exploratory comparator; does not replace or redefine the 150 prespecified primary/control fits
backbone: torchvision MobileNetV3 Small IMAGENET1K_V1, official weights; all backbone parameters and batch-normalization statistics fixed
preprocessing: Official weight transforms: resize to 256, central crop 224, ImageNet channel normalization. Inputs remain the original 28x28 images; upsampling adds no image detail.
feature: 576 dimensional output after average pooling and before the original classifier
learned_head: Training-standardized features; linear 576 to 7 head (4039 learned parameters), no augmentation
training: Same ten lesion-grouped development partitions, AdamW 0.002, weight decay 0.0001, batch 256, maximum 60 epochs, patience 10 on tuning macro F1; separate calibration temperature
selection_scope: Motivated by development fitting failure; no transfer-reference hyperparameter selected from test results
corruptions: The same prespecified 23 conditions, five Gaussian-noise realizations, with frozen backbone/head
uncertainty: 1000 lesion-cluster C draws; image draws for E/PH2, conditional on the fixed ensemble; reported separately from ten-head training variation
interpretation: External ImageNet pretraining and different preprocessing prevent attribution of differences to architecture alone
